notes: The purl.PURL type-reference test asserts concrete field values on the stored elements rather than mere assignability so it is not a shape-only check. No standalone NormalizeEcosystem test was emitted because the target only relies on equality between two NormalizeEcosystem calls, which the SupportedEcosystems tests already exercise with the exact inputs the target passes.
